providerRecord.evidence: The official Latin-American Spanish promo asset is retained as SPEC-0033. It reads the complete printed code "SVP LA 184", carries the "Aventuras Compartidas" stamp, and uses "Plancha Dinámica". SPEC-0034 retains the publisher's European-Spanish comparison, which instead reads "SVP ES 184", carries "Juntos de Aventuras", and uses "Presión Dinámica". This positive pair establishes a separate LATAM/es-419 release without inferring finish or completeness. Retrieved 2026-08-11.
